message.content:
Based on my search, here is the information about PreLicenseTraining login:

## Main Login Portals

**For Students:**
- The main student login page is at **https://prelicensetraining.com/login**
- You will need your login name (which may be your email address) and password
- If you don't have an account yet, you can register at https://prelicensetraining.com/register

**For Mentors/Recruiters/Companies:**
- Mentor login: **https://prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login**
- Alternative mentor portals:
  - https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
  - https://infinityschools.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login

## Additional Features

- **Forgot Password**: If you've forgotten your password, there is a password recovery option available at https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/forgotPassword
- **StudyHall**: PreLicenseTraining.com provides a virtual online practice testing center with hundreds to thousands of updated test questions

## About PreLicenseTraining.com

PreLicenseTraining.com provides insurance pre-licensing and continuing education training with:
- Streaming video instruction
- Online textbook materials
- Hundreds of practice examination questions with correct rationale and tips
- 24/7 access from any location

If you're having trouble logging in, make sure you're using the correct portal for your account type (student vs. mentor).

Sources:
1. https://prelicensetraining.com/login
2. https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login

4. https://prelicensetraining.com/register
5. https://prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
6. https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/forgotPassword
